Which events the project stores: built-in events are stored once enabled, custom events unless
blocked.

Usage:
  voidhash events policy <command> [flags]

Commands:
  view       Show which built-in events are stored and which custom events are blocked.
  enable     Start storing a built-in event, such as $pageview.
  disable    Stop storing a built-in event.
  block      Stop storing a custom event.
  unblock    Store a blocked custom event again.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash events policy <command> --help' for more about a command.
